correctness.rationale: The binary origin recursion is exact; its supermartingale and logarithmic/inverse-fraction decompositions give C_n log n/n -> 1/a. The centered directional ratio has summable drift and conditional quadratic variation under C_n >= n^(3/4), hence a finite a.s. limit. Conditional on autonomous origin indicators, the directional ratio divided by a positive finite binary-path product is L2-martingale; its conditional terminal mean depends on the first independent uniform neighbor color, proving nondegeneracy. The standalone exact verifier checked 3,990 rational finite-state cases of the critical drift formula; finite tests are not substituted for infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The physical model predicts uniform nearest-neighbor concentration while a separate sharp origin law fixes only total missing mass. The new nondegenerate random vector identifies how individual neighbor frequencies fluctuate at the critical 1/log n scale, the same order as the total deficit, and shows the uniform limiting profile conceals persistent sample-specific directional bias. This is a natural structural stochastic boundary effect, not a numerical or renamed scalar result.
